name: Ruou can
summary: Rượu cần is locally brewed fermented glutinous rice wine, poured around a fire at night with gongs. In the villages, homemade wine is drunk through a long bamboo straw.
origin: Mang Den and Konbring village, known for traditional homemade wine.
culture: Homemade wine through a long bamboo straw belongs to the ceremony, with gongs, drums, flutes, and string instruments. Rượu cần goes around the fire at night, with gongs.
howToEat: Drink it around the fire at night.
At the cultural night, rượu cần comes with cơm lam, grilled chicken, pork skewers, and bánh nếp.
where: Konbring village, for traditional homemade wine.
The cultural night at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, held after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
The weekend market’s center stall sells wine products.
seoTitle: Ruou can in Mang Den — bamboo-straw wine
seoDescription: Rượu cần, locally brewed fermented glutinous rice wine, poured around the fire at night in Mang Den.
